vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A dependency with a known advisory does not wait for the shared preset's weekly window.

packageRules.description: Base-image digest bumps are unscheduled, because the image scan in .github/workflows/docker.yml gates on them. Both FROM lines in the Dockerfile are pinned by digest and the runtime stage does not apt-get upgrade, so a rebuild cannot take a Debian security fix — only a new digest can. Debian republishes bookworm-slim when it ships one, Renovate raises that as a digest update, and until it merges the scan is red on every pull request and releases are blocked. Leaving this in the Monday window would make that a week.
